cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(attach_dv_example C)

# Export compile commands for clangd and other tools
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)
add_executable(attach_dv attach_dv.c)

# Provide feature macro expected by some headers
target_compile_definitions(attach_dv PUBLIC DEFINE_DEFAULT_ENGINE_BASE)

# Include headers generated by the Rust FFI build (if present)
target_include_directories(attach_dv PUBLIC
  "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../target/ffi-headers"
)

# Link directory: look for Rust-built libraries in workspace target/debug
target_link_directories(attach_dv PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../target/debug")

# Link against the Rust FFI library if available (name: delta_kernel_ffi)
find_library(DELTA_KERNEL_FFI NAMES delta_kernel_ffi libdelta_kernel_ffi PATHS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../target/debug" NO_DEFAULT_PATH)
if(DELTA_KERNEL_FFI)
  target_link_libraries(attach_dv PUBLIC ${DELTA_KERNEL_FFI})
else()
  message(WARNING "delta_kernel_ffi library not found in target/debug; build the Rust ffi crate first")
endif()

# No extra compile options by default
target_compile_options(attach_dv PUBLIC)

# Copy compile_commands.json to the repository root so clangd (and editors) can find it.
add_custom_target(copy_compile_commands ALL
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
    "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/compile_commands.json"
    "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/../../..//compile_commands.json"
  COMMENT "Copying compile_commands.json to repository root"
)
